_readme: v49.12: names that can't go on the public Juan Top 10 board (juanscores.py / namefilter.py on the server, juan.js on the phone). Lower case, no accents. 'contains': blocked anywhere in the name once it's normalized (accents dropped, 0→o 1→i 3→e 4→a 5→s 7→t @→a $→s, everything but letters removed, repeated letters squeezed). 'words': blocked only as a whole word, or as the whole name. Slurs and the worst English and Spanish profanity; the owner can still rename or delete any entry from /stats.
